verdict.rationale: Zep is a memory/context-graph platform, not an agentic tool-use client; the evidence only shows Zep exposing its own capabilities via MCP servers (Memory MCP Server, Graphiti MCP Server) for other clients like Claude/Cursor to consume — the opposite direction from 'plugging MCP servers into Zep so it can use their tools.' Acting as an MCP client to consume external tool servers is outside Zep's product category (context storage/retrieval, not agent orchestration).
